# GENERATED FILE. Do not edit by hand.
#   python tools/generate_offices.py
#
# Household offices. See the docstring in the generator for why offices are
# auto_modifiers keyed on country variables rather than traits.
#
# The appoint and vacate effects are parameterised on $OFFICE$ rather than
# generated forty-three times, because Clausewitz substitutes parameters inside
# variable names (cc_bond_aor_effects.txt:34 does the same thing).
#
# WHICH SIDE HOLDS WHAT. The country holds cc_office_<key>_filled (the office is
# occupied), cc_office_<key>_level (published for scales_with) and
# cc_office_<key>_holder. That last one exists ONLY so the panel can print a name:
# GUI can dereference a character held in a variable and script cannot. Nothing in
# this file reads it. The holder instead carries cc_office_held_<key>, so every
# lookup is an iteration filtered by a flag, which is the same shape mentorship,
# patronage, schools and secondment already use.
#
# All effects here run in COUNTRY scope.

# scope:office_holder = the minister being appointed.
cc_office_appoint = {
	save_scope_as = cc_office_court

	set_variable = { name = cc_office_$OFFICE$_filled  value = yes }
	set_variable = { name = cc_office_$OFFICE$_holder  value = scope:office_holder }

	scope:office_holder = {
		set_variable = { name = cc_office_held_$OFFICE$  value = yes }
	}

	cc_office_publish_levels = yes
}

# Ends the office and clears the holder's flag. The every_character sweep is affordable
# because vacating is rare: it happens on an advance retiring the office, or when the
# holder dies or leaves the cabinet, never on an ordinary tick.
cc_office_vacate = {
	every_character = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_held_$OFFICE$ }
		remove_variable = cc_office_held_$OFFICE$
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_$OFFICE$_filled }
		remove_variable = cc_office_$OFFICE$_filled
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_$OFFICE$_holder }
		remove_variable = cc_office_$OFFICE$_holder
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_$OFFICE$_level }
		remove_variable = cc_office_$OFFICE$_level
	}
}

# Publishes every holder's level so scales_with can read it. ONE pass over the
# cabinet, not one per office: the inner ifs are variable checks on a character
# already in scope, which is far cheaper than 43 separate iterations.
#
# cc_level (not cc_xp_level) is the 1-10 seniority variable; see the contract
# in cc_xp_effects.txt.
cc_office_publish_levels = {
	save_scope_as = cc_office_court

		limit = {
			in_cabinet = yes

# An advance retired one or more offices. Country-level checks only, no
# character iteration, so this is cheap enough to run on the monthly pulse.
# Fires the notification once if anything was actually wound up.
cc_office_retire_obsolete = {
	set_variable = { name = cc_office_retired_any  value = 0 }

	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cc_office_seneschal_filled
			NOT = { cc_office_seneschal_exists = yes }
		}
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = seneschal }
		change_variable = { name = cc_office_retired_any  add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cc_office_master_of_coin_filled
			NOT = { cc_office_master_of_coin_exists = yes }

		change_variable = { name = cc_office_retired_any  add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cc_office_consul_of_merchants_filled
			NOT = { cc_office_consul_of_merchants_exists = yes }
		}
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = consul_of_merchants }
		change_variable = { name = cc_office_retired_any  add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cc_office_chancellor_of_the_see_filled
			NOT = { cc_office_chancellor_of_the_see_exists = yes }
		}
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = chancellor_of_the_see }
		change_variable = { name = cc_office_retired_any  add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cc_office_keeper_of_the_kurultai_filled
			NOT = { cc_office_keeper_of_the_kurultai_exists = yes }
		}
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = keeper_of_the_kurultai }
		change_variable = { name = cc_office_retired_any  add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cc_office_master_of_the_yam_filled
			NOT = { cc_office_master_of_the_yam_exists = yes }
		}
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = master_of_the_yam }
		change_variable = { name = cc_office_retired_any  add = 1 }
	}
	if = {

		}
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = phanariote_secretary }

		change_variable = { name = cc_office_retired_any  add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cc_office_keeper_of_regnal_chronicles_filled
			NOT = { cc_office_keeper_of_regnal_chronicles_exists = yes }
		}
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = keeper_of_regnal_chronicles }
		change_variable = { name = cc_office_retired_any  add = 1 }

			NOT = { cc_office_master_of_the_silk_road_exists = yes }
		}

		limit = {
			has_variable = cc_office_master_of_ceremonies_filled
			NOT = { cc_office_master_of_ceremonies_exists = yes }
		}
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = master_of_ceremonies }
		change_variable = { name = cc_office_retired_any  add = 1 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			has_variable = cc_office_retired_any
			var:cc_office_retired_any > 0
		}
		trigger_event_silently = { id = cc_office.2 }
	}
	remove_variable = cc_office_retired_any
}

# Publishes which offices are open, for the Household panel tab ONLY.
#
# The panel cannot work this out for itself. GUI can dereference a character
# held in a variable, but it has no way to ask whether a NAMED advance has been
# researched: IsResearched exists only on an AdvanceItem handed out by the
# advances screen's own datamodel, and there is no by-key lookup. So the roster
# has to be pushed out as country variables the panel can test with IsSet.
#
# Human courts only. No panel ever renders an AI household, and this is the one
# effect here that exists purely to feed the UI.
cc_office_publish_roster = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			cc_office_seneschal_vacant = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_office_seneschal_open  value = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_seneschal_open }
		remove_variable = cc_office_seneschal_open
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			cc_office_master_of_coin_vacant = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_office_master_of_coin_open  value = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_master_of_coin_open }
		remove_variable = cc_office_master_of_coin_open
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			cc_office_herald_of_arms_vacant = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_office_herald_of_arms_open  value = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cc_office_herald_of_arms_open }
		remove_variable = cc_office_herald_of_arms_open

# scope:target = a minister who has just died or left the cabinet. Exact, and
# reached only from on_cabinet_death / on_cabinet_removed, so no iteration is
# needed to work out which office (if any) they held.
cc_office_on_holder_left = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:target ?= { has_variable = cc_office_held_seneschal } }
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = seneschal }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:target ?= { has_variable = cc_office_held_master_of_coin } }
		cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = master_of_coin }
	}
	if = {

# Save migration. Converts a minister still holding one of the six original
# office traits into the matching office and removes the trait.
#
# COUNTRY scope, so it cannot live in cc_xp_init (character scope) the way
# cc_xp_ladder_backfill does. It is called from cc_office_monthly behind the
# cc_office_migrated flag instead, which runs on the first monthly tick after a
# save is loaded. on_game_start would be wrong for the same reason it was wrong
# for the ladder backfill: it does not run when an existing save is loaded.
#
# The six traits are kept as always = no shells in cc_age_traits.txt purely so
# this can read and remove them. See the header there.
cc_office_backfill = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_cabinet_character = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = seneschal }
			cc_office_seneschal_vacant = yes
		}
		random_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = seneschal }
			remove_trait = trait:seneschal
			save_scope_as = office_holder
		}
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = seneschal }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_cabinet_character = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = master_of_coin }
			cc_office_master_of_coin_vacant = yes
		}
		random_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = master_of_coin }
			remove_trait = trait:master_of_coin
			save_scope_as = office_holder
		}
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = master_of_coin }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_cabinet_character = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = herald_of_arms }
			cc_office_herald_of_arms_vacant = yes
		}
		random_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = herald_of_arms }
			remove_trait = trait:herald_of_arms
			save_scope_as = office_holder
		}
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = herald_of_arms }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_cabinet_character = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = marshal_of_the_court }
			cc_office_marshal_of_the_court_vacant = yes
		}
		random_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = marshal_of_the_court }
			remove_trait = trait:marshal_of_the_court
			save_scope_as = office_holder
		}
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = marshal_of_the_court }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_cabinet_character = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = court_chaplain }
			cc_office_court_chaplain_vacant = yes
		}
		random_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = court_chaplain }
			remove_trait = trait:court_chaplain
			save_scope_as = office_holder
		}
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = court_chaplain }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_cabinet_character = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = court_astrologer }
			cc_office_court_astrologer_vacant = yes
		}
		random_cabinet_character = {
			limit = { in_cabinet = yes  has_trait = court_astrologer }
			remove_trait = trait:court_astrologer
			save_scope_as = office_holder
		}
		cc_office_appoint = { OFFICE = court_astrologer }
	}
}
